newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 Feb same-store sales up 19.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 Feb same-store sales up 19.2 pct.

text.p: Pier 1 Imports Inc on Thursday reported sales for the four-week period ended March 1, 1997, of $61.4 million, down 6.5 percent from last year's five week $65.7 million.
On a four-to-four week comparison, total sales rose 21.7 percent. Same-store sales rose 19.2 percent from the year earlier period, using a four-week comparison.

Sales for the 13-week fourth quarter of $285.2 million were up 16.7 percent, compared with last year's 14 weeks. Total sales rose 24.5 percent on a 13-week comparison. Same-store sales for the 13 weeks increased 18.1 percent.
"February sales results were the continuation of robust revenue gains that the company has experienced for the last 18 months," said Clark Johnson, chairman and chief executive officer.
"Pier 1 Imports completed the successful elimination of its apparel merchandise category and entered FY '98 as a true specialty retailer of decorative home accessories."

Pier 1 Imports is North America's largest specialty retailer of imported decorative home furnishings, gifts and related items with 727 stores in 47 states, Puerto Rico, Canada, the United Kingdom, Japan and Mexico.
